stem:
This list shows requirements that were written into certain laws in Southern states after the Reconstruction Era.

• must own property
• must pay poll taxes
• must pass literacy tests

Which aspect of society was affected by these requirements?

options.label: A
options.text: U.S. citizens' ability to take out loans

options.label: B
options.text: U.S. citizens' right to vote in elections

options.label: C
options.text: U.S. citizens' option to join the military

options.label: D
options.text: U.S. citizens' choice to operate a business

visual_elements: box containing bullet points: must own property, must pay poll taxes, must pass literacy tests
